import_from_path: import a Python module and class or function dynamically from a file path string
calibration_forward_context: run calibration forward passes with gradient disabled, eval mode, and cache disabled
disable_quantization_context: disable quantization temporarily during model forward passes and restore it afterward
eval_context: temporarily set a PyTorch module to eval mode and restore training mode afterward
disable_lm_head: disable the language model head by moving its weights to the meta device to save memory
